description: This Java source file defines the DataTableValidator class, which provides validation methods for data table registration and advanced query search within the Fineract project. It handles JSON parsing, parameter validation, and enforces constraints on query data structures.

classes.name: DataTableValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for validating data table registration and advanced query search requests, ensuring correct parameters and data structures.

methods.name: validateDataTableRegistration
methods.description: Validates the JSON input for data table registration, checking for unsupported parameters and validating the category parameter.

methods.name: validateTableSearch
methods.description: Validates an AdvancedQueryRequest object for table search, including nested query data and table/query parameters.

methods.name: validateTableSearch
methods.description: Validates an AdvancedQueryData object for table search, focusing on query data validation.

methods.name: validateQueryData
methods.description: Validates the contents of an AdvancedQueryData object, including column filters, filters, operators, and result columns.
